**Finding: Deviation (medium) — GOVLAW, § 20(h) / p0146**

The agreement's governing-law provision sits in the general-matters block on Page 10 rather than in § 20 itself:

> "(h) This Agreement shall be governed by the laws of Nova Scotia and the laws of Canada applicable in Nova Scotia. All disputes under this Agreement shall be subject to the non-exclusive jurisdiction of the courts of Nova Scotia."

Two problems: (1) Nova Scotia/Canada is outside the accepted list of New York, Delaware, California, or England and Wales; and (2) the venue is *non-exclusive*, so we could still be dragged into an unaccepted forum. There is no arbitration clause anywhere in the document (the only "arbitration" reference is a cost head in the IP indemnity at p0090), so the courts-not-arbitration requirement is met and this is not a walk-away.

**Redline accepted (ok:true)** — minimal edit to the jurisdiction and forum words only, leaving the sentence structure intact: New York law, exclusive jurisdiction of the state and federal courts in New York County. Delaware/California or England and Wales (London courts) offered as fallback in the comment.
